payload.rationale: The supplied official-site evidence, retrieved September 19, still advertises a December 18, 2026 North American release, international release beginning December 16, and early-access screenings December 14–15. With roughly three months remaining, this specific rollout supports a low probability of a delay past December 18. My transfer assumption—not an observed production fact—is that a major studio generally becomes less likely to move a tentpole once its release is this close and its promotional schedule this specific. A release on December 18 would not itself meet the stated 'past December 18' threshold. My estimate could be too high if post-production is essentially finished and distribution commitments make the date highly secure. It could be too low if unresolved effects work, an operational disruption, or a strategic scheduling change threatens the release; the advertised schedule does not establish readiness.
limitations: No direct evidence of production completion, remaining post-production work, or internal studio scheduling decisions was supplied.
This is a judgmental estimate without a fitted historical delay base rate or independently verified current reporting.
The packet is narrow and notes placeholder text on parts of the official site.

Full frozen settlement rules were not supplied; geographic scope and treatment of limited or early-access screenings may affect resolution. The estimate follows the stated delay-past-December-18 event and deadline.
